pre_data: Claims, counters and the junk generator freeze before any claim data lands. Every constant is read with `git show <freeze>:reports/round-82/claims.json`, never from the graded tree. Both counters refuse a non-40-hex revision, a freeze that is not an ancestor of lands, lands equal to the frozen base (the do-nothing control; lands equal to the freeze is graded, never refused), an unreadable or incomplete frozen config, and a leg list that disagrees with their own leg table (LEGCOUNT). The entry sha pinned here was computed from the worktree bytes that land unchanged at claim D's lands commit. Claim C (QUALITY 30) is verified by its own counting command and receipt, not by a round counter: see its entry in claims[].
